notes: May require a source port with increased limits / BSP2 support.
metadata.title: Solomon's Tower (The Pentagonal Seal)
metadata.description: Medium grey brick map floating in thick green fog. Based on a Map Center doodle challenge entry.

notes: This is an optimized, stand-alone version of the level which stays within the vanilla Quake limits and does not require any special engine port. It does not include the custom item boxes from the previous version.
metadata.title: Midnight Stalker (v.2)
metadata.description: Medium-sized metal dungeon in E3M6 mashup style with a built-in skill selection room. It also features custom item boxes. The map source is included.

metadata.title: Odyssey One
metadata.description: Large Wizard map. Originally created in 1998, this version has been rebuilt by Bengt Jardrup (aguirRe) to make it playable in modern engines.

notes: Enhanced skins are available: regular and DP version.
These maps require an engine port with increased limits.
metadata.title: Soul of Evil: Indian Summer (update)
metadata.description: Updated version of nsoe, comes with a new map. Medieval/fantasy episode consisting of five medium to large maps - sequel to Soul of Evil. Also features new and modified monsters, weapons and items as well as a story in the vein of SOE unfolding throughout the maps, many custom textures, sounds and skyboxes. Gameplay is somewhat non-linear and very hard.

metadata.title: Feindlich Sewers v1.0
metadata.description: Medium sized castle / medieval sewers map with Makkon textures. The author's first release.

metadata.title: Rune Keep
metadata.description: Transparent water version of runekeep: a large, detailed Medieval fortress.

metadata.title: Penumbra of Domination
metadata.description: Episode with four varied, medium to large Wizard maps, as well as a start map. Also features some modified progs, like rotation, breaking walls and cutscenes.

metadata.title: ALSC Deathtrap
metadata.description: A office-like deathmatch map that has a few monster in SP too. Marbleous...

notes: This map requires Quoth and an engine port with increased limits.
metadata.title: Conference of the Shamblers
metadata.description: Huge Knave-style fortress with many enemies and secrets. The map source is included.

metadata.title: DMxSP - The Deathmatch Experience
metadata.description: The original Quake deathmatch maps converted for single player mode.

notes: These maps require a source port with increased limits + BSP2 support. Additionally, due to the large filesize of the skybox and music, the memory heapsize must be increased. A smaller version of the skybox is available here.
metadata.title: Adoria
metadata.description: Two base maps: a space ship hangar and a huge UAC facility with labs, tech areas, offices, personel quarters and a cantina. It attempts to connect Wolfenstein, Doom and Quake. It runs on the Progs_dump mod (included), uses many new textures, and comes with additional assets, a custom skybox and music tracks in WAV format.
